==Quest information==
===Requirements===
*This quest is only offered to [[level]] 20 [[character]]s.

===Objectives===
*Complete a [[Guild versus Guild|guild battle]].
*See Zenjal <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] Guide] for your reward.

===Reward===
*2,500 [[Experience]]
*[[Champion's Zaishen Strongbox]]

==Walkthrough==
Travel to your [[Guild hall]] with [[Automated tournament#GvG tournament requirements for participants|at least four players]] and start a [[guild]] battle. Your guild does not have to win, but one guild must lose in order to complete this quest.

==Dialogue==

;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]

:''"The pinnacle of combat on these islands is found in the guild battles: a war for pride and honor, fought between mighty alliances of adventurers. I warn you, it will take all your might and cunning to survive a handful of minutes in such a fray. Knowing this, will you still press on?"''
